brief_title: Effects of Fimasartan on Insulin Secretion in Type 2 Diabetic Patients
official_title: Effects of Fimasartan on Insulin Secretion, and Interaction With DPP4 Inhibitors in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: This study was designed to evaluate the effect of ARB in improving insulin secretion in patients with type 2 diabetes. The investigators also aimed to evaluate if there are potential synergisms between ARB and DPP4 inhibitors in improving insulin secretion and urinary albumin secretion in diabetic patients.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 20\~80 years
* Type 2 diabetic patients diagnosed more than 6 months ago
* HbA1c ≤8.5% at screening
* No change of OAD within the 3 months before screening
* SBP \<140 mmHg and DBP \<90 mmHg with anti-hypertensive drug at screening
* SBP ≥140 mmHg or DBP ≥80 mmHg without anti-hypertensive drug at screening

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetic patients or active insulin treatment at screening
* Treatment with ARB or ACEi within 1 month prior to screening
* Uncontrolled hypertension with SBP \>170 mmHg or DBP \>100 mmHg
* Pregnancy or lactation
* Elevated liver enzyme (AST or ALT \> 3 times the UNL) or elevated serum Cr (≥1.5 mg/dL in men and 1.4 mg/dL in women)
